issues.detail: The runner has no FastAPI/SQLModel/testcontainers packages, no Docker and no PostgreSQL, so the established suite cannot run (selfChecks confirm conftest import fails, docker absent, pip/apt installs fail). The case does not state that the suite runs, and none of the four assertions requires an executed result; registries and Debian mirrors are blocked so the role cannot substitute an installed database. A correct run ends with an incomplete report in TESTING, which graderOnly tells the judge.
issues.fix: None; harness limitation documented in graderOnly.

issues.detail: contains 'app/surveys/router[.]py' assumes the report names the full path. The template's Source file column and Assessed Inputs make this near-certain, but a run writing only 'router.py' in the budget row would still almost surely name the full path elsewhere in the report.
Reading styles has no deterministic predicate in the vocabulary; left to the judge with complete:false, which is correct.

summary: The fixture realizes every stated condition: a brownfield FastAPI/PostgreSQL survey service in TESTING after a FORWARD handoff, scope with AC-001..003, a single-file change in app/surveys/router.py, and a suite built on dependency_overrides and a testcontainers PostgreSQL. Checks are necessary conditions, and the invariants fit a Tester. The suite cannot execute in the runner, but the case does not require execution and graderOnly documents it.
